items.reflection: Paddles for a Purpose was OttoTHON's first-ever pickleball tournament. Held in a round-robin style competition accompanied by a fun-filled raffle generously donated by our sponsors, we were proud to raise $2,089 in support of Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital!
items.desc: Join us for our first OttoTHON Pickleball Tournament benefiting Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital, hosted by both OttoTHON and Student Government Association (SGA)!
items.title: Paddles for a Purpose

items.reflection: Participants of Ottothon dance during their fundraiser, ending the night having raised $115,182.76 for the children being treated at Upstate Golisano Children’s Hospital in Syracuse, NY.
items.desc:
OttoTHON is a Dance Marathon fundraiser that lasts from 11 AM - 10 PM! All of the funds raised will benefit the children and families at Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital. The day will consist of food, dancing, fundraising, games, a parade to the hospital, guest speakers, interactions with kids from the hospital, and more!

All participation at this event will count for any service hour requirements needed on campus/in Greek Life.
items.title: OttoTHON 2026

items.desc: New year, new walls! Stop by the Quad and stock up on posters, prints, and dorm room decor to kick off the semester right. OttoTHON has teamed up with Global Prints to bring you a huge selection at prices that won't break your student budget. Swing by between classes, grab your favorites, and help support OttoTHON's mission for Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital while you're at it!
items.title: Back to School Poster Sale with Global Prints

items.desc: OttoTHON tabled to promote their "Dare Week" awareness-raising push for Upstate Golisano Children's Hospital through "Pie an E-Board Member" and other challenges.
items.title: Dare Week - Pie an E-Board Member

items.desc:
Tonight, we gather to honor the children whose lives were taken too soon and to hold their families, loved ones, and memories close to our hearts.

Each candle represents a life that mattered, a story that deserves to be remembered, and a light that will never be forgotten. 🩵

Join us for our Candlelight Vigil as we remember, honor, and celebrate the lives of these incredible children.
items.title: Miracle Week - Candlelight Vigil

items.desc: Come Pie a friend or a member of OttoTHON to raise awareness for Children's Health!
items.title: Miracle Week - Pie-a-Friend

items.reflection:
To everyone who donated, fundraised, attended an event, or helped make this week possible: THANK YOU! Every dollar brings us one step closer to ensuring that no kid has to fight alone and that every child gets the childhood they deserve. 🫶

This is what happens when our community comes together for a cause bigger than ourselves. We couldn’t have done it without YOU!📣

In total we raised $23,115.16 over the span of Miracle Week!
items.desc:
The big week is just starting! Join us October 7th from 5–7 PM in HOL 207 for our Miracle Week Hype Room! 🩵

We’ll be raising funds, playing games, bringing the energy, and kicking off an unforgettable week together.✨

You won’t want to miss the opening act, we will see you there
